answer: A cryptoeconomic AI network deters Sybil attacks by requiring cryptographic staking coupled with continuous verification challenges. Each agent must lock collateral, akin to freezing a digital glacier, to participate in consensus tasks. If an agent fails validation or acts maliciously, its stake is burned like an expiring ember, stripping the attacker of capital. Meanwhile, isolated compute nodes form a verifiable island of trusted peers, completely cutting off unverified identities from network rewards and governance power.
